title: How does Linus make money? - 2020 Update
summary: Linus Tech Tips gives its 2020 breakdown of how the company earns money, including ads, sponsors, merch and affiliate links. It includes a pie chart of revenue sources.
why: HN cites it as concrete data on how a big YouTube channel diversifies revenue and how little comes from AdSense.

quote.text: Linus tech tips did an enlightening breakdown video of their earnings
